storage_classes.name: Standard

price.note: Archival Storage doc price table: Standard 'EUR 0.0184 per GB/month' ('rounded monthly approximations'; billing is per GiB-hour). Exact rate (pricing page / price API sos.storage_volume_tier1): EUR 0.0000275 per GiB-hour for Tier 1 (up to 512 TiB).

Tier 2 (512 TiB to 1 PiB): only an hourly rate is published, EUR 0.00001875 per GiB-hour (price API https://portal.exoscale.com/api/pricing/sos, storage_volume_tier2, read 2026-10-13); no monthly figure is stated by Exoscale, so none is recorded.
Tier 3 (more than 1 PiB): only an hourly rate is published, EUR 0.00001389 per GiB-hour (price API storage_volume_tier3, read 2026-10-13); no monthly figure is stated.

put_per_1000.note: The pricing page lists no request fees for Object Storage (only storage volume tiers and networking); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

get_per_1000.note: The pricing page lists no request fees for Object Storage (only storage volume tiers and networking); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

list_per_1000.note: The pricing page lists no request fees for Object Storage (only storage volume tiers and networking); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

price_per_gb.note: Pricing page, Object Storage table: Standard Volume tiers 'Retrieval (EUR): Free'.

typical_delay.note: Not applicable (hot storage); no delay stated.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing page, Object Storage table: Standard tiers 'Minimum duration: None'.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Pricing page footnote [2]: 'A minimum billable size of 128 KiB per object applies' (limits doc: 'Minimum billed size 128kb'). Value is in KiB.

notes: Tiers are cumulative: the first 512 TiB at Tier 1, 512 TiB to 1 PiB at Tier 2, above at Tier 3 (pricing page footnote [1]). Band limits converted from TiB/PiB (binary) to GB.
The price API returns the same numbers for EUR, CHF and USD; the account currency depends on the customer's legal residence (pricing FAQ).

storage_classes.name: Archival Storage (on request)

price.note: Archival Storage doc: 'EUR 0.0042 per GB/month' (rounded monthly approximation; pricing page: EUR 0.00000626 per GiB-hour). Billed as Standard usage with a monthly discount line on the invoice.

put_per_1000.note: The pricing page lists no request fees for Object Storage (only storage volume tiers and networking); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

get_per_1000.note: The pricing page lists no request fees for Object Storage (only storage volume tiers and networking); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

list_per_1000.note: The pricing page lists no request fees for Object Storage (only storage volume tiers and networking); absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

typical_delay.note: Not stated; enrolled buckets keep the same S3 endpoints and access (archival doc says nothing changes technically), but no delay figure is given.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing page: Archival Storage 'Minimum duration: None'.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Pricing page footnote [2]: 'A minimum billable size of 128 KiB per object applies' (limits doc: 'Minimum billed size 128kb'). Value is in KiB.

notes: Activated per bucket on request and reviewed against the access pattern. Each enrolled bucket is billed for at least 10 TB (metered as 9,313 GiB), i.e. a floor of EUR 42/month; below about 2.3 TB Standard is cheaper (archival doc).
No object lock or retention on enrolled buckets.
Warm (EUR 0.009/GiB retrieval, 30 days) and Cold (EUR 0.027/GiB retrieval, 90 days) classes are announced for early 2027 and are not modelled.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No free egress allowance is stated for Object Storage. The pricing page's free outbound traffic tier (1.42 GiB/hour per running instance, about 1 TiB/month) is described for compute instances; whether it covers SOS egress is not stated.

price.note: Pricing page 'Networking OUT per GiB', value from the price API (sos.storage_traffic, eur): EUR 0.02 per GiB. Normalised to per GB (1 GiB = 1.073741824 GB).

notes: Networking IN is free; traffic between zones and between instances, SOS and DBaaS is free (pricing page).
Archival Storage buckets pay standard egress rates (archival doc).

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use rule for Object Storage egress is stated; egress is billed per GiB.

free_tier.note: No free tier for Object Storage was found on the pricing page or product page.

object_lock.note: Docs: 'Exoscale SOS implements the S3 compatible object lock feature' (legal hold and retention); must be enabled at bucket creation and requires versioning; not available on Archival Storage buckets.

s3_endpoints.label: Geneva
s3_endpoints.note: Quick start: 'Storage API Endpoint: https://sos-{zone}.exo.io'; s3cmd config uses host_bucket = %(bucket)s.sos-{zone}.exo.io (virtual-hosted style). The AWS CLI guide sets region to the zone name.
